sourceSentences: [0] a champion like Camille normally wants to take a short trade especially with grasp and W probably you can take a long trade against her most of the time especially if your passive is down
[0] so it's really important that you figure out when to take long trades or short trades
[1] va avir le Level 2 avant moi malheureusement elle a pas le E donc elle peut pas dash
[1] tout on lu fait perdre le passif très important ça big cherche pas la tuer je cherche juste à la faire reset
[1] magnifique elle perd le passif limite plus Z aussi mais ça me permet de le garder pour un une autre action
[2] Okay, guys. Let's start W. Yeah, level one. We have less cool down than the Hercu spell. Let's get level two.
[2] Was a really good trade, guys. There. She didn't respect the level two advantage.
[3] Try to bait her shield by doing a useless trade (like just let her auto you and run away) and after it runs out use that window to take a good trade.
[3] If she takes grasp she's a bit stronger in early short trades but has less threat in all-ins, while with conq it's the opposite, play accordingly.
[3] If you W her Q2 you have good chances to win the trade or at least go even. You can W her E too.
[3] Don't give her free Ws as she will outsustain you if you let her poke with those too much, just try to bait them and if she misses too many she runs out of mana and you win.
[3] Never 1v1 in sidelane if she's not massively behind and just play for teamfights. Skill 1-5, win 6-9, lose after trinity if even.
[3] Save your W for her E. Camille have no wave clear so try to freeze then all-in her. Late game 1v1 she might beats you. Dodge her E and you're fine.
